title: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP)
application_deadline: 2026-02-25 (2026/2027 cycle closed; next cycle expected late 2026/early 2027)
eligibility_summary: Citizens of 34 eligible countries (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Egypt, Ethiopia, Georgia, Guatemala, Indonesia, Iraq, Jordan, Kenya, Liberia, Malaysia, Mexico, Moldova, Morocco, Nigeria, Peru, Philippines, Rwanda, Senegal, South Africa, Tanzania, Thailand, Uganda, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, Zambia). Must have work experience (3,000 hours for most countries; no minimum for Eastern European exceptions), leadership experience, be liable for tuition fees, and be admitted to an eligible master's programme.
funding_details: Full tuition fee coverage; monthly allowance of SEK 12,000; one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine); SI Network for Global Professionals membership; alumni network membership.
status: Closed for 2026/2027; upcoming 2027/2028 cycle expected (dates TBD on official site)

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship Pioneering Women in STEM
application_deadline: 2026-02-25 (2026/2027 cycle closed; next cycle expected late 2026/early 2027)
eligibility_summary: Female citizens from 10 countries in Africa and Asia: Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya, Malaysia, Nigeria, Philippines, Rwanda, South Africa, Thailand, Vietnam. Must be admitted to an eligible master's programme in STEM fields at a Swedish university.
funding_details: Full tuition fee coverage; monthly allowance of SEK 12,000; one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000 (SEK 10,000 for certain countries); SI Network membership; alumni network membership.
status: Closed for 2026/2027; upcoming 2027/2028 cycle expected (dates TBD on official site)

title: KTH Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Fee-paying international students (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) who have applied for a master's programme at KTH as their first priority via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Must demonstrate academic excellence and drive to contribute to sustainable development.
funding_details: Covers full tuition fee for the first and second year of a one- or two-year master's programme (provided study results during the first year are satisfactory). Does not cover living costs.
status: Upcoming for Autumn 2027 intake; dates officially announced on KTH website

title: KI Global Master's Scholarship
application_deadline: End of April 2027 (results; application period February 2027)
eligibility_summary: Tuition fee-paying students who have applied for a master's programme at Karolinska Institutet and ranked a KI programme as their first choice. Approximately 10-12 scholarships awarded annually from ~700-1000 applicants.
funding_details: Covers full tuition fees only. Does not cover living expenses, accommodation, or travel.
status: Upcoming for 2027 intake; application period announced as February 2027

title: Lund University Global Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied for a degree programme at Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se and paid the application fee. Merit-based; financial need not considered.
funding_details: Grants may cover part or all of tuition fees (up to 100%). The percentage awarded depends on programme/faculty budget. Does not cover living costs. Approximately SEK 26 million awarded annually.
duration: Duration of the degree programme (up to 2 years for Master's)
status: 2026 cycle closed; upcoming 2027 cycle expected early February 2027

title: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
eligibility_summary: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must demonstrate academic talent and have applied for a Master's programme at Uppsala University as first priority via universityadmissions.se. Highly competitive (~2% success rate).
funding_details: Covers full tuition fee for an international Master's programme. Does not cover living expenses.
status: 2026 cycle closed; upcoming 2027 cycle expected early 2027

title: Stockholm University Scholarship Scheme
application_deadline: 2027-01-15 (expected; follows university admissions deadline; 2026 cycle was 2026-01-15)
application_opening_date: Notification of selection results (expected late March/early April 2027)
eligibility_summary: Citizens from countries outside EU/EEA/Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. Must be admitted to a Master's programme at Stockholm University in the first (international) admission round. Priority given to students with Stockholm University as first choice on universityadmissions.se.
funding_details: Covers the whole tuition fee for a Master's programme. Does not cover living costs. Results announced by end of April.
status: 2026 cycle closed; upcoming 2027 cycle expected for Autumn 2027 intake

title: Malmö University Master's Scholarship
application_deadline: TBD (2026 cycle closed; typically follows admission notification in April)
application_opening_date: After Notification of Selection Results (typically March/April)
eligibility_summary: Students from outside EU/EEA and Switzerland who have applied for an English-taught master's programme at Malmö University as first choice, been admitted, and are required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied in the first admissions round and paid the application fee.
funding_details: Covers partial or up to full tuition fee. Does not cover living expenses. Students who successfully complete the first year retain the scholarship for the second year of two-year programmes (minimum 45 credits per academic year).
status: 2026 cycle closed; upcoming 2027 cycle expected for Autumn 2027 intake

title: Lund University African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA) Scholarship
application_opening_date: Early February 2027 (expected; applicants notified by email when portal opens)
eligibility_summary: Students who have been enrolled at an ARUA member university in Africa (including University of Cape Town, University of Ghana, University of Nairobi, University of Lagos, etc.) and are citizens of a country outside the EU/EEA required to pay tuition fees. Must have applied to Lund University as first choice via universityadmissions.se.
funding_details: Covers up to 90% of tuition fees. Does not cover living costs. Scholarship recipients must independently fund living expenses according to Swedish Migration Agency requirements.
duration: Duration of the master's programme (up to 2 years)
status: 2026 cycle closed; upcoming 2027 cycle expected early February 2027

title: Stockholm Trio Scholarship
provider: Stockholm Trio (Karolinska Institutet, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm University)
eligibility_summary: Fee-paying students admitted to joint master's programmes within the Stockholm Trio alliance: Master's Programme in Molecular Techniques in Life Science or Master's Programme in Biostatistics and Data Science. Applied via universityadmissions.se with programme as first priority.
funding_details: Covers the full tuition fee for the study period. Does not cover living costs.
status: Upcoming for Autumn 2027 intake; dates aligned with KTH Scholarship

title: KTH One-Year Scholarship
application_deadline: TBD (for current KTH students; typically during first year)
eligibility_summary: Current KTH master's programme students who are fee-paying and perform strongly during their first year. Not available for joint or EIT master's programmes.
funding_details: Covers tuition fee for the second year of studies only. Does not cover living expenses.
status: For current KTH students; application details published during first year of study

title: KTH India Scholarship
funding_type: Full tuition waiver + monthly living allowance
eligibility_summary: Indian applicants admitted to a master's programme at KTH. Applicants from Mumbai and Pune receive priority under the foundation rules, but the scholarship remains open to eligible Indian applicants from other regions. Very competitive (one award offered in 2026).
funding_details: Covers full tuition fee plus a monthly living allowance during ten months of each academic year. Funded by the KTH India Scholarship Foundation.
status: Upcoming for Autumn 2027 intake; dates expected to align with KTH Scholarship
